query: what is the current state of all indicator lights?

tools.name: get_light_status
tools.description: Get whether each indicator light is currently on or off.

tools.name: get_clock_time
tools.description: Get the current time shown on the clock.

tools.name: read_logs
tools.description: Show, list or view the saved log entries of one log column, or of all columns when no column is given. These are the manual logs, not the terminal.

column.description: Which log column. Omit for all columns.

tools.name: get_terminal_history
tools.description: Show the history of commands typed in the terminal. Not the log entries.

tools.name: toggle_light
tools.description: Turn one indicator light on or off.

state.description: true to turn the light on, false to turn it off.

tools.name: set_log_entry
tools.description: Record or change an entry in the blue, yellow or red log column: the state of that column at a time. If an entry already exists at that time it is changed.

column.description: Which log column: blue, yellow or red.

time.description: The time of the entry, 24-hour HH:MM, for example 14:30. Omit for the current time.

left.description: Blue column only: left half on (true) or off (false).

right.description: Blue column only: right half on (true) or off (false).

on.description: Yellow column only: light on (true) or off (false).

tools.name: delete_log_entry
tools.description: Delete one log entry. The entry is found by the time it was logged.

column.description: Which log column: blue, yellow or red.

time.description: The time of the entry to delete, 24-hour HH:MM.

tools.name: clear_logs
tools.description: Delete ALL log entries in one column. Destructive.

column.description: Which log column to clear.

tools.name: export_logs
tools.description: Export all log data as JSON or CSV.
